Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before the next call.

X-Rate-Limit-Limit.description: The capacity of the budget that refused the call.

X-Rate-Limit-Remaining.description: The tokens left in that budget; 0 on a refusal.

orgUnit.description: The ship's org unit; null for none, absent to keep it

ProblemDetail.description: An RFC 7807 problem. code is the stable, machine-readable reason; a client compares it, never the localized title or detail.

code.description: The stable reason, one of the values in x-problem-codes (the ProblemCode registry, REQ-API-019). The exchange operations under /api/v1/exchange answer the codes of the frozen exchange contract instead (ExchangeProblemException). The list grows; a client treats an unknown code by its status.

correlationId.description: Finds the request in the server log.

errors.description: Validation failures as field to message; see fieldErrors.

fieldErrors.description: Validation failures, one per field or parameter (VALIDATION_FAILED, CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION).
